demo_desc.title: Solving Two-Step Equations
demo_desc.body: This mathematics visualization helps students learn and solve basic two step equations with one variable. Students will have to experiment with the features of the demo, interact with the objects (apples and candies), and investigate what rules make the scale equal. Our demonstration promotes visual and hands-on learning, as opposed to instruction guided memorization techniques. We will guide students in the right direction, but students playing with the demo for 5-10 minutes should receive a basic sense of how to solve basic equations (2x+12=5x+3). The many visualization techniques in the demo should help kids visualize the objects on the scale, inspiring creativity and deep thinking. Students can also try very simple, automatically generated practice problems in a visual manner.

about.text1: Conception is a non-profit fundraiser created by a group of freshmen at Needham High School with one thing in common: A love of math.
about.text2: We want to share our love of learning to younger audiences by teaching more complex mathematical ideas to younger elementary students in creative and visual ways. For instance, we will teach students how to solve two-step equations with visual demos. That way, it is easy to understand AND fun to learn! By associating math with fun experiences, we can help educate and bring back interest in math at a time of decreasing interest (see home page for more info).
